title: Senior ML Research Engineer, Virtual Cell
description: About SandboxAQ SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors. We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders. At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact. The Opportunity The AI Sim R&D team builds leading-edge ML and physics-based models ("LQMs") to advance drug discovery. Within this team, AQCell is our virtual cell platform: it takes a cell representation (e.g. basal gene expression) and a perturbation descriptor (e.g. SMILES, dose, and time), predicts the resulting transcriptomic response, and maps that response through pathway activity to functional endpoints such as cell viability, IC50, and toxicity dose-response — helping drug discovery scientists understand the biological repercussions of a compound across the cell, not just whether it binds its target. As a Machine Learning Engineer on AQCell, you will build and maintain the models and data infrastructure that power this pipeline. You will work across large, heterogeneous transcriptomic and functional-endpoint datasets (e.g. LINCS L1000, GDSC, Tahoe-100M, and DILImap), train and evaluate expression-perturbation and cell-viability prediction models over them, and help harden our evaluation pipeline and baselines so we can trust and improve model performance over time. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning and biology, and offers the opportunity to shape how virtual cell models are trained, validated, and scaled toward real drug discovery decisions. Key Responsibilities Model Development: Build, train, and maintain machine learning models for expression-perturbation prediction (e.g. transcriptomic response to a drug perturbation) and downstream functional-endpoint prediction (e.g. cell viability, IC50, toxicity dose-response). Large-Scale Dataset Management: Acquire, harmonize, and manage large-scale biological datasets (e.g. LINCS L1000, GDSC, Tahoe-100M, DILImap) — including schema harmonization, normalization, and de-duplication across cell, drug, and assay identifiers — and manage model training pipelines over these pooled datasets. Evaluation & Baselines: Contribute to automating and hardening the end-to-end evaluation pipeline, including implementing robust statistical baselines (e.g. cell- and drug-conditioned mean baselines) to rigorously benchmark model performance. Research Translation: Translate ideas from the scientific literature (e.g. transformer-based perturbation models, knowledge graph and GNN-based embeddings) into working, well-tested code integrated into our modeling framework. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with computational biologists, software engineers, and product stakeholders to ensure models are grounded in sound biology and are usable in real drug discovery workflows. Communication: Clearly document methods, assumptions, and results, and communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Essential Skills & Experience Academic Foundation: Bachelor's degree in a scientific or quantitative field (Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, or related); an advanced degree (MS or PhD) is preferred. Applied ML in Science: Demonstrated experience building and maintaining machine learning models in a scientific discipline in an industry setting, including taking models from prototype through validation and maintenance; experience in a life sciences setting is preferred. Large-Scale Data Management: Required experience managing large-scale datasets and managing the training of models over them, including data ingestion, cleaning, versioning, and pipeline maintenance at scale. Software Engineering: Strong Python programming skills and experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, JAX) and experiment tracking/data versioning tools (e.g. Weights & Biases). Scientific Rigor: Ability to design sound evaluation methodology (e.g. train/test splitting strategies, held-out generalization tests) and to critically interpret model performance against meaningful baselines. Highly Desired Skills & Experience Bioinformatics & Computational Biology: Experience with bioinformatics and computational biology data analysis tools, particularly transcriptomics harmonization and normalization tools (e.g. batch correction, pseudobulking, gene ID mapping/standardization). Domain Datasets: Familiarity with public perturbation or drug-sensitivity datasets such as LINCS L1000, GDSC, DepMap, or single-cell perturbation atlases. Knowledge Graphs & GNNs: Experience with knowledge graph embeddings or graph neural networks applied to drugs, targets, or cells. Cheminformatics: Familiarity with cheminformatics representations (SMILES, InChI keys, PubChem/Cellosaurus identifiers) used to harmonize drug and cell metadata across datasets. Collaborative Innovation: Experience working in interdisciplinary environments where AI intersects with the biological sciences. Why Join Us? We offer competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional growth. Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation. Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents with generous employer premium contributions, retirement savings with company matching, paid parental leave, and inclusive family-building benefits. Work-Life Balance: Flexible paid time off, company-wide seasonal breaks, and support for flexible work arrangements that enable sustainable performance. Career Development: Opportunities for continuous learning and growth through on-the-job development, cross-functional collaboration, and access to internal learning and development programs. SandboxAQ Welcomes All We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging and respect, where diverse perspectives are actively sought and valued. Our multidisciplinary environment provides ample opportunity for continuous growth - working alongside humble, empowered, and ambitious colleagues ready to tackle epic challenges. Equal Employment Opportunity : All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Accommodations : We provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in job application procedures for open roles. If you need such an accommodation, please let a member of our Recruiting team know. Proven pre-sales experience covering discovery, qualification, scoping, proposal development, and presenting solutions to executive buyers. About the team

SumUp is building a consumer financial product with a distribution advantage that almost no other fintech can replicate.

More than four million merchants use SumUp, and more than a billion consumers come into contact with our products each year. We now have the opportunity to turn that reach into one of the world's largest consumer financial ecosystems.

Our consumer product is already live across six European markets. The next challenge is to grow it from an emerging proposition into a product used by millions of consumers, and this role will lead that journey.

This role sits at the heart of that growth. As Senior Marketing Manager (Merchant to Consumer), you'll drive the merchant-to-consumer acquisition engine: the channel that converts SumUp's merchant network and their customers into SumUp personal banking customers.  This is a rare chance to build a differentiated acquisition channel from scratch inside a small, ambitious team, competing head-to-head with some of the best-funded neobanks in Europe.

description: CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies. We’re on a mission to make businesses more human, and humans more impactful. We operate by our values — be intentional, pursue excellence every day, embrace the journey together, and be a good human — every day. CreatorIQ has earned the title of best companies to work for in multiple programs, including BuiltIn LA and NY. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub. We operate in a flexible work model that combines both in-person and remote work to boost collaboration, enhance innovation, and adapt to individual work styles. We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together! Director of Product, Workflows CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies run their creator marketing programs on. A large customer works with thousands of creators a year across dozens of programs and several markets, and every one of those partnerships has to be sourced, vetted, agreed, briefed, tracked and paid for. You'll own that operational core and lead the product teams that cover it today, accountable for making the whole thing feel like one operation instead of a series of handoffs. The mandate is to rebuild that operation around AI. Tooling in this category, ours included, was designed for a world where a person did each step by hand, and it still assumes that. It scales by adding people. A community manager keeping a 2,000-creator program on track lives in spreadsheets. An agency casting 300 creators against a brief in a week gets there by throwing bodies at it. Your job is to change what the software is responsible for, so programs scale without the headcount and the people running them spend their time on decisions that need judgment. In this role, you’ll get to: Own the workflow end to end. Discovery, Lists, Community, Campaigns and Messaging are one continuous job for our customers, and today they feel like separate products. Making them one, and making most of it happen without a human clicking through it, is the mandate. Lead and grow a team of product managers. You'll set the bar for how they work, coach them on discovery and judgment, and give them enough room to own their surfaces without you in the middle of every decision. Decide what gets rebuilt agentically, what gets simplified, and what gets deleted. Plenty of our existing workflow exists because someone needed a manual solution in 2020. Some of it should be automated, some should be replaced by a better model of the problem, and some should just go away. Get the trust model right. Provenance, confidence, human-in-the-loop review, honest failure, and clean rollback are what decide whether an enterprise customer lets an agent touch a live campaign. Partner with engineering and design leadership on architecture and delivery. Schema, core service, bulk operations, permissions, the data model that both the UI and the agents read from. You need to be credible in those conversations, not just present for them. Who you are and what you’ll need for this position: You've spent 8+ years in product, including 2+ leading product managers. Titles matter less than the work, but we need someone who has managed PMs before and knows the difference between coaching and taking over. You've owned a broad, workflow-heavy B2B SaaS surface where the product is the customer's daily job. You have a builder's mindset and haven't stopped being hands-on. You prototype. You use AI tools to build the thing rather than write a doc about the thing, and you expect the same from your team. You've rebuilt a manual workflow around AI and know the difference between removing the work and putting a chat box in front of the same twelve clicks. You're fluent in the mechanics too: retrieval, tool use, evaluation, human-in-the-loop review, and where an agent shouldn't be allowed to act alone. You have real product taste and you use it on AI output. You can look at an agent's plan, a generated brief, or a search result and say why it's good or why it's plausible-sounding filler. You ask the same question of a big customer's request or an inherited roadmap item: does this actually solve the problem? You're technical enough to hold your own on data model and API design. Schemas, CRUDL, bulk operations, permissions, third-party integrations. You can tell when a small-sounding request is touching something structural. You can prioritize across teams with genuinely competing claims and explain the tradeoff so the people who lost the argument still understand it. You write well. Most of how we work is async and in docs, and a Director who can only communicate in meetings will not scale here. You take initiative and own outcomes. You don't wait to be told the priority, and you'd rather bring a proposal than a list of questions. You're curious, self-driven, low-ego, and allergic to "that's not my job." Comfortable working with distributed teams across time zones. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call. Nice to have Experience with influencer marketing, creator workflows, or martech. Experience building search, discovery, or recommendation products, including semantic or multimodal search. Experience shipping CRM, relationship management, or lifecycle products. Experience shipping AI features into enterprise accounts where governance, auditability and permissions were part of the deal. Experience hiring product managers and building a team from a partial bench. Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow. What you will get from us: People: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do. Guidance: Utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you'll need to become successful here from your first day with us. Work/life harmony: 25 days of vacation, floating and company holidays, wellness benefits, and paid parental leave. Whole Health Package: Comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, mental health support, life insurance, income protection, and other wellness benefits. Planning for the future: A Royal London Pension Plan to help you plan ahead. Equity: Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program. Work from home stipend: To assist you in setting up a home office that works for you. Who we are: CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth, helping global brands and agencies transform creator marketing into an intelligence-driven growth engine. Powered by the Creator Graph™, which processes more than 250 million social posts daily across more than 15 million creators worldwide, CreatorIQ unifies fragmented platform data into a centralized intelligence layer and system of record for creator relationships, performance, governance, and commerce. More than 1,300 organizations—including Dentsu, Delta Air Lines, Google, Beiersdorf, Nestlé, and Wella—rely on CreatorIQ as the infrastructure to run and scale their creator programs globally. CreatorIQ is a global company headquartered in Los Angeles with offices in Austin, New York, San Francisco, London, Manila, and Warsaw. Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram . At CreatorIQ, we believe that diversity is the key to unlocking our full potential. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, being a good human, and staying focused on what’s important, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry. Compensation, Benefits and Beyond: We understand that a comprehensive benefits package plays a significant role in your overall compensation. To gain more insight into the various components of our total compensation, we invite you to review our benefits and perks . AI Transparency Notice We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice . description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>Commercial Manager, Global Supply Chain</h2> <p>We're looking for a Commercial Manager, Global Supply Chain to join our team. This is a global role spanning the DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt ecosystem, with Deliveroo as the hiring entity. Deliveroo, and Wolt ecosystem.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Sourcing Strategy &amp; Execution</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Translate category strategies into actionable sourcing plans</strong> across warehousing, last-mile fulfilment, apparel, manufacturing, and consumables, driving consolidation across our brands.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <p>Contract &amp; Supplier Management</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Own the end-to-end contracting process</strong> in partnership with Legal, maintaining a complete contract register and enforcing lifecycle obligations, renewals, and rebates.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Drive day-to-day commercial supplier management</strong>, conducting structured performance reviews, establishing operational KPIs, and managing Joint Improvement Plans.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Mitigate supply chain risk and ensure continuity of supply</strong>, establishing dual-sourcing strategies, financial risk assessments, and strict ethical sourcing/modern slavery compliance across manufacturing partners.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Partner with operational and logistics leadership</strong> to align requirements, streamline specifications, and build credibility across historically independent regional teams.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <h3>What You’ll Need to Thrive</h3> <p>Essential</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Significant experience in supply chain sourcing</strong>, with a proven track record delivering measurable commercial value across logistics, 3PL, or manufactured goods categories.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Demonstrated ability in end-to-end competitive sourcing</strong>, including hands-on contract negotiation with major international suppliers and manufacturing partners.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Proven capability in supplier relationship and performance management</strong>, with experience handling complex commercial disputes and driving joint innovation.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Strong analytical and financial acumen</strong>, with expertise in total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling, landed cost structures, and spend analytics.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Exceptional stakeholder influence</strong>, with the ability to bridge operational needs with commercial outcomes across multi-region or cross-brand environments.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <p>Nice to Have</p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience sourcing apparel or hardgoods manufacturing, including factory selection, quality control, and ethical audit frameworks.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience leading post-acquisition supplier consolidation or specification harmonisation.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with direct/inventory-based supply chains, including international freight, customs/duty, and working capital dynamics.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Why Join Us?</h3> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.</p> <p>We’re food lovers, problem title: Senior Branch Merchandiser
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.</p> <p>At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.</p></div><p>As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Branch Merchandiser will play a critical role in setting the branch merchandising strategy across retail stores and international locations.</p> <p><strong>ROLE OVERVIEW</strong></p> <p>This is a newly created role that offers the opportunity to set the branch merchandising strategy and ownership structures across retail stores in the UK with scope to expand across additional international locations. The successful candidate will evolve and streamline the existing critical path — currently spread across multiple teams — into a cohesive approach to range planning, space planning, and allocation strategy, establishing clear processes across commercial functions. The Senior Branch Merchandiser delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.</p> <p><strong>HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT</strong></p> <p>Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.</p> <p><strong>Team &amp; Leadership Impact</strong> (Build Championship Teams)</p> <ul> <li>Build strong working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally with Retail, Buying &amp; Merchandising, Logistics, and Finance teams to ensure alignment and delivery against commercial objectives.</li> <li>Partner with supply chain and logistics to forecast short-term retail dispatch and DC volumes, and to determine the best delivery day, method, and frequency for each store.</li> <li>Gain buy-in at Senior Management level through excellent communication and influencing skills, presenting data-backed strategies and recommendations with confidence and clarity.</li> <li>Define the ownership structure and clear processes across the commercial functions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fan &amp; Customer Impact</strong> (Obsessed with Fans)</p> <ul> <li>Deliver an optimised, balanced range for retail that meets and exceeds sales and margin targets, ensuring fans in every store have access to the right product at the right time.</li> <li>Conduct regular store visits to gather market intelligence and competitor analysis, translating insights into actionable range and space recommendations that elevate the in-store fan experience</li> <li>Partner with Heads of Retail and General Managers to identify existing and new commercial opportunities that drive availability and satisfaction across all store grades.</li> <li>Feedback market intelligence and analysis to Buying &amp; Merchandising teams to inform future ranging decisions and strengthen the end-to-end fan offer.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Innovation &amp; Problem Solving</strong> (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)</p> <ul> <li>Trial and propose new ideas to move the business forward, including evolving allocation and replenishment systems for greater efficiency and accuracy.</li> <li>Manage specific projects end-to-end — documenting and analysing information, formulating conclusions, and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Potentialise sales and profit opportunities by store grade, using commercial analysis and data to unlock performance improvements across the estate.</li> <li>Develop and implement best practice distribution methods in partnership with merchandising and supply chain teams, optimising delivery frequency and stock flow.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ownership &amp; Execution</strong> (Determined &amp; Relentless Mindset)</p> <ul> <li>Set commercial initial allocations by category aligned with planned store turnover, space, and cover, and implement and manage the seasonal allocation and replenishment strategy by department and category.</li> <li>Analyse and review weekly, monthly, and seasonal trade by store and grade versus budget and prior year, proposing short, medium, and longer-term corrective actions with pace and precision.</li> <li>Manage store openings, modernisations, closures, and space changes in close collaboration with Buying &amp; Merchandising teams to deliver successful launches on time and on brief.</li> <li>Oversee the smooth flow of stock across stores, maximising potential through initial allocation, re-assortments, and end-of-season stock removal to Outlet.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI &amp; DIGITAL CAPABILITY</strong></p> <p>We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:</p> <ul> <li>Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes</li> <li>Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance</li> <li>Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working</li> <li>Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement</li> </ul> <p><strong>CAPABILITIES &amp; EXPERIENCE YOU BRING</strong></p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in a fast-paced Retail Merchandising or Space Planning role, ideally within a multi-site High Street or omnichannel retail environment.</li> <li>Strong commercial acumen with a deep understanding of store grading, range optimisation, space planning, and allocation and replenishment strategy.</li> <li>Excellent numerical and analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex trading data and translate it into clear, actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence and communicate effectively at all levels, including gaining buy-in from Senior Management on strategic decisions.</li> <li>Experience managing store openings, closures, or estate changes in collaboration with buying, merchandising, and logistics functions.</li> <li>A collaborative, cross-functional working style with the ability to build effective relationships across retail, B&amp;M, logistics, and finance teams.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills and a solutions-focused mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure and deliver to deadlines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WORK LOCATION</strong></p> <p>Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Manchester, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence <strong>3 days per week.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.</em><br><br><strong><em>ABOUT US</em></strong><br><em>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.</em></p> <p><strong><em>ABOUT THE TEAM</em></strong><br><em>Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, <a href="http://www.fanatics.com">www.fanatics.com</a>.</em><br><br><em>Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).</em><br><br><em>At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:</em><br><em>· Build Championship Teams</em><br><em>· Obsessed with Fans</em><br><em>· Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit</em><br><em>· Determined and Relentless Mindset</em></p> <p><em>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our&nbsp;<a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p>Senior Contracts Manager</p> <p>Location – UK - Windsor/ Edinburgh / Ireland - Dublin &nbsp;</p> <p>Type of Work - Office</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Role Overview</u></strong></p> <p>We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Contracts Manager to join the UKI Legal team. The role will support business growth and financial objectives by managing legal and commercial risk and enabling effective delivery of software and services to the NHS, and other UK &amp; Ireland (UKI) healthcare and non-healthcare customers.</p> <p>The Senior Contracts Manager will play a key role in managing contracts across their full lifecycle, working closely with the Legal, Sales, Delivery and Leadership teams to ensure contractual arrangements align with business objectives, governance requirements and public sector procurement norms.</p> <p>As the senior contracts role in the UKI Legal team, the Senior Contracts Manager will generally be assigned the most complex, high-value and strategically significant matters. They must also operate with substantial autonomy within an agreed mandate, and help set standards, draft regional and global processes, and develop capability across the contracts function.</p> <p>This role will be based in either InterSystems’ Windsor, Edinburgh, or Dublin offices and may require occasional domestic and international travel. Office location will be determined based on the successful candidate’s location. An office location that is not Windsor will require periodic attendance at the Windsor office.</p> <p><strong><u>Key Responsibilities </u></strong><strong>– The role encompasses end-to-end contract lifecycle management, including pre-contract support, post-contract management, and risk and governance oversight.</strong></p> <p><strong><em>Pre-Contract Activities</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead legal team input into assigned tender and bid responses, particularly for NHS and other public sector procurements.</li> <li>Draft, review and negotiate a range of customer and supplier contracts, ensuring alignment with business objectives, legal and commercial risk appetite, and applicable NHS and public sector requirements.</li> <li>Provide pragmatic and commercially focused contractual advice to support sales and project mobilisation activities.</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Post-Contract Management</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Take named, end-to-end ownership of a defined portfolio of client contracts, including high-value and complex contracts, holding accountability for commercial outcomes across the contract lifecycle.</li> <li>Manage contracts following signature, including business adherence to contractual obligations, change control processes and contract variations.</li> <li>Support the delivery and operations teams in the practical application and management of contractual obligations throughout the contract lifecycle.</li> <li>Monitor contractual performance, compliance and key post-signature obligations.</li> <li>Support the management of third-party vendors/sub-contractors and suppliers, both local and global, as required.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em>Risk and Governance</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the implementation, day-to-day governance, administration and continuous improvement of regional and global AI-enabled legal support technologies, ensuring effective, compliant and business-aligned usage across the legal function.</li> <li>Identify, assess and escalate legal and commercial risks to appropriate internal stakeholders and, where necessary, internal or external legal counsel.</li> <li>Implement and ensure adherence to internal contract management and governance processes.</li> <li>Manage ambiguity and develop practical, proportionate solutions to contractual and risk management challenges.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em>Stakeholder Engagement</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide clear, practical guidance on contractual matters to colleagues at all levels, including the Legal, Sales, Delivery and Leadership teams.</li> <li>Mentor and develop contract managers and other colleagues, setting standards and sharing best contract management practice across the global legal team.</li> <li>Coordinate with local and international colleagues to resolve contractual issues efficiently.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Experience/Qualification Required </u></strong></p> <ul> <li>A minimum of 7-9 years proven, hands-on experience in high-value contract management, ideally within healthcare, IT, and/or the public sector. As a guide to applicants, evidence of a directly accountable portfolio TCV over £100M is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience of operating with autonomy on high-value, complex and strategically significant contracts, and of leading negotiations through to conclusion.</li> <li>Strong drafting, negotiation and analytical skills, with a pragmatic and commercially focused approach.</li> <li>Comfortable working with digital workflow tools, document automation systems, and AI enabled legal support technologies to improve contract review speed, accuracy, consistency, and compliance.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience of legal operations processes, contract lifecycle management platforms and AI-enabled legal technologies is highly desirable.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience of using UKI model form contracts and frameworks, with an understanding of government and NHS procurement laws and public sector contracting norms.</li> <li>Ability to identify, define and articulate key commercial principles to support sound legal and business outcomes.</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to explain complex contractual issues to non-specialists.</li> <li>Sound judgment, strong organisational skills and attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.</li> <li>Degree and/or postgraduate qualifications with a legal or commercial focus are preferred; relevant professional qualifications are welcomed.</li> <li>Experience with AI-related regulatory environments such as the EU AI Act is an advantage.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>About InterSystems</strong></p> <p style="font-weight: 400;">InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, InterSystems has 38 offices in 28 countries worldwide. For more information, please visit&nbsp;<a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https://www.intersystems.com/&amp;esheet=53379223&amp;newsitemid=20230410005415&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=InterSystems.com&amp;index=4&amp;md5=3edf749fa33f5a2ac0c355c410576e90" data-outlook-id="1e721f69-f681-4067-9281-970e94b3ef11"><strong>InterSystems.com</strong></a>.</p> <p style="font-weight: 400;">&nbsp;</p> <p style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>AI Disclaimer</strong></p> <p>InterSystems may use AI tools for its internal operations including administrative tasks during recruitment (e.g., organizing candidate information). &nbsp;InterSystems’ approach to AI is guided by the <a href="https://www.intersystems.com/ai-use-guidelines/">InterSystems Responsible AI Guidelines</a>. AI is not used to make or influence hiring decisions. All decisions are made by InterSystems employees.</p> <p>Candidates may use AI for CV or interview preparation, provided materials are truthful and reflect their own experience. &nbsp;AI tools and third-party transcription services must not be used during interviews or assessments.</p> <p>Please note that the use of wearable technology, including any AI-related tools or other technology-connected devices (such as META or Google smart glasses and/or wearables, and/or any similar devices), is<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><em>strictly prohibited</em><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>during the interview and screening process with InterSystems.&nbsp; Any applicant who requires a wearable device or any type of technology support during the interview process as a reasonable accommodation under the ADA or applicable state or country laws and regulations must contact the InterSystems Human Resources Department<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><em>prior</em> to attending or participating in any interview or screening process.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Hi 👋 I'm Deyan, Director of Corporate Marketing at hyperexponential. I lead Corporate Marketing: brand creative and design, PR and communications, flagship events, and owned media. We partner with teams across the business to produce a high volume of long-form and short-form content. A podcast episode or a report becomes clips, articles, exec posts, and social across everything the department touches. I'm hiring a Content Operations Associate to help turn that into a repeatable operation. You'll build the pipelines that carry our content from raw material to published output, run them day to day, and make each cycle better than the last. You'll work across every part of the department rather than sitting inside one slice of it. It's an operations role, not a strategy one. That's deliberate. You'll be close to the editorial thinking without owning it, and your job is the machinery underneath. If that's the kind of problem you want to solve, I'd love to hear from you. About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry: which risks to take and how to price them. These decisions shape real-world outcomes. Whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has made billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally. We're already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do. From building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Impact isn't tied to title or tenure. It's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the team Marketing at hx builds authority and demand in a niche, technically complex space. This isn't volume-driven marketing. It's deliberate, high-quality work where every output is expected to earn its place. This role sits in Corporate Marketing: brand, content, flagship events, PR and comms, design and multimedia, and owned media. We partner with teams across the business to produce a high volume of long-form and short-form content. The opportunity now is to turn that into a repeatable operation. The pipelines that take a podcast episode or a report and turn it into clips, articles, exec posts and social. You'll help build those pipelines, run them day to day, and make each cycle better than the last. It's an operations role rather than a strategy one. You'll be close to the editorial thinking and pick up plenty of it, but your job is the machinery that carries it. Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining. What you'll be doing Map how hx's content actually gets made. The tools, the sequence, the hand-offs, and where it breaks. Keep that picture current as the operation changes around it. Run the production cycle across our content programmes (customer stories, the podcast, thought leadership and executive comms). Brief our agency partners, hold the quality bar on what comes back, and hit the publish dates. Take a growing share of that work in-house as you learn how it runs. Draft copy for new web pages and projects. We draft with Claude against a codified brand voice, so you're never starting from blank. Work with input from internal SMEs and run the loop between programme owners, designers and agency partners. Brief in, feedback consolidated, builds QA'd, pages live on the date agreed. Keep the hx thought leadership calendar operationally sound. Set the schedule, make the call on what runs when, chase the drafts, and cut existing long-form into the clips, posts and articles that feed our channels. Keep the operations behind our named-voice programme running. The scheduling, the queue, the approvals, the chasing. So the experts and execs who carry our thought leadership post on cadence without having to manage the process themselves. Build the templates, prompts and share packs the wider team publishes from. Good work shouldn't depend on you being available. Learn how we stay visible in AI-generated answers as well as search results. Work out how that content gets published and distributed across the blog and website. You'll start by running these cycles with support. Within a year we'd expect you to own them end to end and have a view on what we build next. What we're looking for You'll need to take on ownership and responsibility from the start, whatever your level. We care more about how you work than how long you've worked, and we don't expect you to have done all of this before. You've made and published something (a newsletter, a channel, a society page, client work) and found yourself more interested in how it got made than in the making. You're organised in a way other people can see. You track what's outstanding, you follow up, and you flag problems early rather than absorbing them. You use AI properly in your own work. Reusable prompts and templates that make a recurring task faster, not a tool you tried once. You pick things up by using them rather than waiting to be trained. Familiarity with a CMS, a scheduling tool, or a project tracker. You're unlikely to thrive here if You expect full product maturity, clear roadmaps, and well-defined processes before taking action - hx moves fast and requires comfort operating in ambiguity where products, priorities, and messaging are still evolving. You focus primarily on flashy launch work or brand campaigns rather than the detail-oriented, outcomes-driven work of deepening adoption, engagement, and user understanding. You struggle to prioritise or make trade-offs without perfect information, waiting for others to decide rather than using judgment to move work forward with the context available. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining.

What you'll be doing

Map how hx's content actually gets made. The tools, the sequence, the hand-offs, and where it breaks. Keep that picture current as the operation changes around it.

Run the production cycle across our content programmes (customer stories, the podcast, thought leadership and executive comms). Brief our agency partners, hold the quality bar on what comes back, and hit the publish dates. Take a growing share of that work in-house as you learn how it runs.

Draft copy for new web pages and projects. We draft with Claude against a codified brand voice, so you're never starting from blank. Work with input from internal SMEs and run the loop between programme owners, designers and agency partners. Brief in, feedback consolidated, builds QA'd, pages live on the date agreed.

Keep the hx thought leadership calendar operationally sound. Set the schedule, make the call on what runs when, chase the drafts, and cut existing long-form into the clips, posts and articles that feed our channels.

Keep the operations behind our named-voice programme running. The scheduling, the queue, the approvals, the chasing. So the experts and execs who carry our thought leadership post on cadence without having to manage the process themselves.

Build the templates, prompts and share packs the wider team publishes from. Good work shouldn't depend on you being available.

Learn how we stay visible in AI-generated answers as well as search results. Work out how that content gets published and distributed across the blog and website.

You'll start by running these cycles with support. Within a year we'd expect you to own them end to end and have a view on what we build next.

What we're looking for

  • You'll need to take on ownership and responsibility from the start, whatever your level. We care more about how you work than how long you've worked, and we don't expect you to have done all of this before.

  • You've made and published something (a newsletter, a channel, a society page, client work) and found yourself more interested in how it got made than in the making.

  • You're organised in a way other people can see. You track what's outstanding, you follow up, and you flag problems early rather than absorbing them.

  • You use AI properly in your own work. Reusable prompts and templates that make a recurring task faster, not a tool you tried once.

  • You pick things up by using them rather than waiting to be trained.

  • Familiarity with a CMS, a scheduling tool, or a project tracker.

  • Bonus points if you've got work out of someone you couldn't instruct (an agency, a freelancer, a collaborator) by writing a clear ask and going back when it wasn't right.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You expect full product maturity, clear roadmaps, and well-defined processes before taking action - hx moves fast and requires comfort operating in ambiguity where products, priorities, and messaging are still evolving.

  • You focus primarily on flashy launch work or brand campaigns rather than the detail-oriented, outcomes-driven work of deepening adoption, engagement, and user understanding.

  • You struggle to prioritise or make trade-offs without perfect information, waiting for others to decide rather than using judgment to move work forward with the context available.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process. Our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations. We're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Talent Screening

  2. Hiring Manager Interview

  3. Skills Assessment: a take-home exercise, followed by a review session

  4. Values Interview

  5. Meet the CEO

  6. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do. It's key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, apply or share it with your connections. Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, visit our careers page.

About Userlane

Userlane is a software adoption platform that shows enterprises whether their software and AI investments are actually working. Our team works with some of the biggest names in regulated industries, helping them get real value from technology and giving their employees the right support inside software applications they use every day. Based in Munich, growing internationally.

Userlane combines Application Intelligence and Contextual Assistance for regulated industries. Application Intelligence shows where software creates cost and friction across the estate. Contextual Assistance helps people get work done in the moment, without training burden. We work with healthcare organizations across the US and Europe, helping clinical and operational teams work confidently in complex systems like EHRs and other core clinical and business applications.


Your mission

Own Application Intelligence at Userlane. You'll shape what we build across App Discovery, HEART Analytics and Portfolio Overview to help enterprise CIOs and IT leaders see where software spending delivers value and where it creates waste. You'll work on opportunities such as:

  • Defining metrics that hold up: Own the methodology behind our HEART Analytics, deciding what each score measures, how it's calculated, and how it stays credible when data is incomplete.

  • Delivering outcome-linked metrics: Connect usage data to business outcomes like cost savings, efficiency and compliance risk that enterprise executives can take action on

  • Building for time-poor executives: Design analytics that bring insights to leaders and answers "what should I do?" not just "what happened?"

  • Connecting fragmented data sources: Define the integration strategy to combine Userlane behavioural data with cost data from SAM tools, license data from IT asset management and employee data from HR systems,

  • Transforming insights into action: Define what turns raw usage data into insights that drive action, not just dashboards people look at once

  • AI adoption governance: Extend analytics to measure how AI assistants and agents affect productivity, cost and ROI.


Your profile

  • 5+ years of product management experience on data/analytics products within a modern product organisation

  • You've defined a metrics methodology, scoring system or measurement framework that others build on, and you can defend the trade-offs behind it. You're comfortable reasoning about why one calculation approach produces misleading results in a specific scenario and another doesn't.

  • You start with the business question, not the data. Your first instinct is "what decision are they trying to make?" rather than "what data do we have?"

  • You hold your ground. You'll work with technically strong colleagues and leaders with well-formed opinions. You can disagree with them credibly, engage with their reasoning, and change your position when the evidence says so, not when the seniority does.

  • You can hold a credible conversation with data engineers and data scientists about what the data can and cannot prove, and you understand the difference between interesting data and actionable insight

  • You've worked in enterprise B2B (not B2C product analytics). Healthcare experience is a strong plus

  • You figure out what works by talking to customers and watching them use the product

  • You're capable of explaining things to engineers, salespeople, support agents and CEOs alike

  • You're fluent in English (spoken and written)


What's in for you

  • Team & Culture: A high-performance culture with great leadership and a fun, engaged, motivated and diverse team with people from over 20 countries

  • Impact: You'll be part of an empowered cross-functional team given the freedom and autonomy to solve real customer problems

  • Product strategy influence: Work directly with our VP Product to shape our 2026-2030 strategy as we expand into new sectors

  • Market: Userlane is among the global leaders in the rapidly growing Digital Adoption industry

  • Growth: We take you and your development seriously. You can expect weekly 121s, a personalised skills assessment and development plan, on-the-job coaching and budget for events and training
    Benefits: We offer flexible benefits related to savings and security, health and well-being, and lifestyle and leisure

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About us</h2> <p>We love pets - which is why we’re on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.&nbsp; We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We’ve helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.&nbsp; Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.&nbsp; Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.&nbsp; Want to join our pack?&nbsp; Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.</p></div><h2>A day in the life</h2> <p>As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.</p> <p>This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.</p> <p>You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.</p> <p>Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.</p> <p>We embrace modern development practices:</p> <ul> <li>All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.</li> <li>We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.</li> <li>We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.</li> </ul> <p>As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <h3>ü&nbsp; Build and maintain secure platform foundations</h3> <ul> <li>Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.</li> <li>Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.</li> <li>Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.</li> <li>Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.</li> <li>Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.</li> </ul> <h3>ü&nbsp; Make our security controls provable</h3> <ul> <li>Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.</li> <li>Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.</li> <li>Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.</li> <li>Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.</li> </ul> <h3>ü&nbsp; Strengthen access and identity controls</h3> <ul> <li>Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.</li> <li>Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.</li> <li>Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.</li> </ul> <h3>ü&nbsp; Extend our platform standards beyond AWS</h3> <ul> <li>Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.</li> <li>Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.</li> </ul> <h3>ü&nbsp; Team collaboration</h3> <ul> <li>Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.</li> <li>Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.</li> <li>Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.</li> <li>Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.</li> </ul> <h3>ü&nbsp; Self development</h3> <ul> <li>Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.</li> <li>Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.</li> <li>Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.</li> </ul> <h2>Your skills and experience</h2> <p>We are looking for someone with:</p> <ul> <li>Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).</li> <li>Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.</li> <li>Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.</li> <li>A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.</li> <li>Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.</li> <li>Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.</li> </ul> <p>We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:</p> <ul> <li>A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.</li> <li>Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.</li> </ul> <h2>The interview process</h2> <p>This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.</p> <ul> <li>Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.</li> <li>Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.</li> <li>Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.</li> <li>Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular ‘Hack Weeks’ to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we’re interested in and feel passionately about.</p> <h2>Our tech stack</h2> <p>We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn.&nbsp; You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.</p> <p>Our “north star” is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics.&nbsp; To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean.&nbsp; We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.</p> <p>We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices.&nbsp; We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.</p> <p>Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Salary range:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£55,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£65,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2>Ways of working</h2> <p>On a typical day you’ll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset.&nbsp; You’ll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we’d expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day.&nbsp; We’d ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively.&nbsp; We’ll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.</p> <h2>Inclusion at ManyPets</h2> <p>We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won’t discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback. &nbsp;If you'd like to read more about this, please download our <a href="https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/6htm7c3glth8e7x3sm5xe/Our-Approach-to-Inclusion-Policy-ManyPets-May-24.pdf?rlkey=d0fjswa0v1h6r582kn9mubl9j&amp;st=no0ket4o&amp;dl=0">Approach to Inclusion</a> policy.&nbsp;</p> <h2>Reasonable adjustments and support</h2> <p>If you need any help, support, or advice at any point during the hiring process please email <a ---------- If you want to ask any questions or request an adjustment, please let us know and we'll do what we can to flex our approach.</p> <h2>Connect with us!</h2> <p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/manypets">LinkedIn</a> |&nbsp;<a href="https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-ManyPets-EI_IE2165347.11,19.htm">Glassdoor</a> | <a href="https://uk.indeed.com/cmp/Manypets/about">Indeed</a> | <a href="https://www.feefo.com/en-GB/reviews/bought-by-many?displayFeedbackType=SERVICE&amp;timeFrame=YEAR">FeeFo</a> | <a href="https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/boughtbymany.com">Trustpilot</a> | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/ManyPetsUK">YouTube</a> |&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/manypets_UK">Instagram</a> |&nbsp;<a href="https://www.facebook.com/manypetsuk">Facebook</a> | <a href="https://twitter.com/manypets_uk">Twitter</a> | <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/@manypets_UK">TikTok</a> |&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p> <p><strong>Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience: 3+ years of security incident response in a production-cloud environment&nbsp;</li> <li>Subject-matter expert on security issues and technologies</li> <li>Ability to utilize AI for comprehensive, complex security incident response activities delivering high fidelity detections</li> <li>Advanced knowledge of service-oriented architectures, as well as experience with security tools and technologies fit for a cloud environment</li> <li>Experience working across a technology stack on difficult security challenges and initiatives</li> <li>Experience with SIEM platforms and the ability to extend their functionality</li> <li>Experience with SOAR tools and automating manual security processes</li> <li>Experience in either AWS, GCP, or other large cloud platform</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with every level of the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired:</strong></p> <ul> <li>AI Model Security &amp; Posture Management: Support Implementation of&nbsp; controls and safeguards to prevent AI vulnerabilities, such as prompt injections, model evasion, and data poisoning</li> <li>AI-Driven Threat Response: Utilize GenAI and LLM-based security use cases to rapidly interpret alerts, reduce false positives, and contextualize threat data</li> <li>Artifact &amp; Evidence Triage: Collects intrusion artifacts and forensically sound images to analyze malware, trojans, and source code.</li> <li>Threat Intelligence Integration: Monitors external vendor data and threat intelligence to analyze trends and proactively defend against emerging risks.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> <p>This role will be remote, and based in Ireland or U.K.</p> <p><strong>Travel&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.</p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more.
